notes: YouTube giveaway task expanded from one (Subscribe) to three ordered, independently-rewarded tasks in a single YouTube column: 1) Subscribe (unchanged, Google OAuth), 2) Feature our channel as one of your own channel's featured channels, 3) make a public video that mentions us. Both new tasks are verified automatically with a public Google API key (no OAuth/consent needed - a channel's featured list and a video's metadata are public data), unlike Trustpilot which still needs manual admin review. Giveaway > Settings now has a reward-amount field per YouTube task (shown as a hint when marking a claim rewarded) plus the API key and required-video-keyword fields.
